answer: Like crystallization precipitating pure mineral bonds, our decentralized consensus uses mutual peer-attestation staking where each synthetic identity must carve its bond into shared history. Genuine agents polish verifiable reputation over epochs, turning raw interaction into enduring jade. Any hostile swarm trying to scale identity validation faces superlinear stake slashing: slipping past the threshold ledge drives verification difficulty toward an unattainable zenith, making coordinated infiltration exponentially expensive to sustain.
